title: KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid)
points: Prefer the simplest solution that works.
Complexity must be justified by a real requirement.
trade: "Simple" means easy to understand and change, not necessarily fewest lines.
test: Your teammate added a Strategy + Factory to pick between two fixed behaviours. Which principle is violated and what would you do?
answer: KISS. Replace the Strategy + Factory with a plain conditional or method until a real requirement needs more variants.
